title: model endpoint unreachable
notes: httpx.RequestError branch. Names the method and the URL, which is the most useful thing in the whole E-MODEL class and is why What is 2 rather than 1. The duplicate report -- 'exception calling callback for <Future ...>' plus ~20 frames -- was removed by guarding the futures done-callback now shared by pdl_llms.py and pdl_openai.py (pdl_scheduler.make_model_call_done_callback): a failed or cancelled future returns before any work and before any print, so the failed path has exactly one writer to stderr and the old main-thread/event-loop-thread interleaving cannot occur.
